context: Adds shared debounce and throttle helpers to replace the ad-hoc setTimeout logic scattered across the search and scroll handlers.
explanation: Both implementations are correct: debounce clears and reschedules a single timer per call and exposes cancel() to abandon a pending invocation, while throttle tracks the last call time and schedules at most one trailing call for the remaining interval. Neither leaks timers, and `this`/arguments are forwarded correctly with apply. Good, reusable utility.
